scenario: ARP plays the notes held up in 16ths, and latch keeps it going
name: companion, ST-77: MELODY on the Juno's Xylophone (a clean, quick pitch, dry: no echo to blur it, D-093; it sounds an octave up, 4': C5 E5 G5 for C4 E4 G4), ARP on (MODE up, RATE 1/16 at 90 BPM: 167 ms a step); C4 E4 G4 held: C4, E4, G4 in turn; ARP twice: latch; the keys let go, the pattern goes on and the three keys stay lit; SELECT two on: the rhythm menu, number, name and 16 steps, on 3 hats 2-1 (R-306)
note: PRESETS opens the Sound Browser on Lead (the MELODY template) and K1 to Pad and PRESETS to its last, the Juno's Xylophone; the list has closed when ARP is tapped. Stopped, the arpeggio keeps its own clock at the song's tempo from the first step; each note sounds GATE 50 %, 83 ms.
